description: Compute the daily sales and running (cumulative) total of sales per store. A store may have several rows per day (one per register); first aggregate to one row per store per day, then compute the cumulative sum ordered by sale_date within each store. Only stores with is_active = TRUE are included. Output columns: store_id (INT64), sale_date (DATE), daily_amount (FLOAT64), running_total (FLOAT64). Sort by store_id, sale_date.

amount.description: Sales total for this register on this date

is_active.description: Whether the store is currently operating

edge_cases: Multiple register rows on the same day must collapse into one output row
Days with no sales are not emitted (no gap filling required)
Running total must reset for each store
common_failure_modes: FM3: Applying SUM() OVER directly on register rows yields one row per register and, with the default RANGE frame, identical running totals for same-day rows
FM3: Omitting PARTITION BY store_id accumulates across all stores
